5e3aff88: ;
Edit selected entries
;
Get selected entries from list
If none selected, quit
Otherwise, go into full screen mode
For each selected entry:
  Get IEN and set up FileMan variables
  Call FileMan to edit entry
  Check if entry was deleted and set flag if so
If flag set, refresh list
Quit
;
